ValidationRule.description: Blocks save when Candidate Status changes to non-Active unless user types a genuinely changed reason of at least 50 chars. Active is exempt. Does not fire on new record creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Candidate_Status__c ), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Candidate_Status__c, "Active" ) ), OR( NOT( ISCHANGED( Candidate_Status_Change_Reason__c ) ), LEN( TRIM( Candidate_Status_Change_Reason__c ) ) < 50 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a status change reason of at least 50 characters.
